CustomField.formula:
TRIM( IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Address_Line1__c)), Address_Line1__c + IF( OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Address_Line_2__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Town_City__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Postcode__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Country__c)) ), BR(), "" ), "" ) +
IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Address_Line_2__c)), Address_Line_2__c + IF( OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Town_City__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Postcode__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Country__c)) ), BR(), "" ), "" ) +
IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Town_City__c)), Town_City__c + IF( OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Postcode__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Country__c)) ), BR(), "" ), "" ) +
IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Postcode__c)), Postcode__c + IF( NOT(ISBLANK(Country__c)), BR(), "" ), "" ) +
IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Country__c)), Country__c, "") )
CustomField.label: Full Address
